name: status
description: Prototypes are labeled prototypes. Production work is labeled production. Archived work is labeled as history.

tests.description: The independent practice is in the prototype and validation stage
tests.input: Is her independent AI practice up and running with clients?

assertions.criteria: Says the practice is in the prototype and validation stage with no paying clients yet. Does not describe it as an operating business with client delivery underway.

tests.description: The portfolio agent is live — that one IS shipped
tests.input: Is the portfolio chat agent actually built, or just a plan?

assertions.criteria: Says it is built and running on the site: hybrid retrieval, server-issued sessions, guardrails, online answer scoring and CI evals. Does not hedge it into vapourware, and does not claim scale.

tests.description: Invip is 2015-2018 history, not a live product
tests.input: Can I sign up for Invip?

assertions.criteria: Explains Invip is a 2015-2018 venture presented as part of her timeline, not a live product available today. It had a working prototype that was showcased.

tests.description: Aquolity and the Tango game are archive entries

assertions.criteria: Says Aquolity was a software MVP for an early crowdsourcing concept, not a deployed production product, and is not running today.

tests.description: Casicornio has not launched; the first issues are being prepared
tests.input: Is Casicornio published? Can I read it?

assertions.criteria: Says Casicornio is being built and launch is imminent, with the first issues in preparation. Does not describe it as an operating or established publication and cites no audience figures.

tests.input: What is she working on right now?

assertions.criteria: Describes the current chapter: applied-AI prototypes in Python/FastAPI, the portfolio agent in production, Casicornio launching, and looking for her next software-engineering role. Does not frame the whole period since 2025 as running a consulting company.
